quality: Recognizable and coherent stylized candidate in desktop/mobile closed/open captures; complete model and controls fit. Marketing has stronger grounding, finer surface response and more commanding volcanic relief. No gross missing geometry or definite clipping is visible.
hardware: Corner caps, front clasp, separate round front fitting, side ring and feet are present. Open views show rear hinge fittings and the upright released hasp; its attachment is visually understated, not proven detached. Marketing brass and clasp layering are better resolved.
terrain: Two gray-topped, fluted volcanoes share connected green terrain in a cyan lake inset. Actual peaks read shorter/coarser than marketing, with abrupt gray/green transitions. Summit recesses are not clearly readable even in the original desktop capture and remain subtle on mobile; marketing shows small dark summit openings, not broad crater bowls. Terrain is naturally hidden behind the open lid from this front angle.
texture: Actual body has conspicuous cloudy diagonal blue-gray streaking versus marketing's finer restrained grain. Lake is a flat enamel-like cyan panel and terrain is faceted; this is a finish/fidelity gap, not demonstrated missing maps or UV corruption.
limitations: Read sources/nicaragua/source_readme.md: written brief, not user-approved concept art; procedural stone, stylized terrain and subtle craters are disclosed. Readme reports sampled attachment/collision checks, not continuous or manufacturing certification; those checks were not rerun here. Still images cannot validate animation, custody or phone performance. Mobile is desktop touch emulation. Comparison angles/scales/lighting differ.
decision: Choose whether to accept this stylized interpretation with explicit marketing-to-viewer caveats or request closer crater readability, terrain proportions and finer stone finish. Needs-decision is an art-fidelity decision, not a proven mechanism failure or user approval.

decision: Choose whether the faithful motif/palette match with simplified glaze, pattern seams and hardware finish is acceptable for publication, or request closer promotional finish. No confirmed functional blocker; this is candidate review, not user approval.

decision: Choose acceptance of the stylized ceramic/pattern interpretation or request improved pattern transitions, glaze and hardware definition before claiming promotional equivalence. No demonstrated functional defect; needs-decision does not imply user approval.

decision: Choose acceptance of the stylized terrain and pale procedural stone with honest promotional-finish caveats, or request improved stone/terrain shading and hardware definition. Do not label intended low-poly slopes a proven geometry defect. Candidate review only, not user approval.

quality: Three-boulder/lagoon composition and pale chest closely retain marketing identity. All four original captures fit the complete object and UI. Actual finish is softer, less mineral-rich and less grounded than marketing; no clear major clipping or missing panel is visible.

Open hinges and released hasp are visible, with attachment detail unresolved rather than proven detached. Bright rim-corner joins and conspicuous teal seam merit aesthetic review, not a claim of failed closure.
terrain: Exactly three rounded boulders are readable, largest central with smaller neighbors; actual forms look smoother and more generic than marketing. Turquoise lagoon appears contained inside the pale irregular shoreline in both original closed views. No recurrence of the documented earlier spillover is visible. Lagoon reads as an opaque flat inlay in both reference and candidate; open-front naturally hides it.
texture: Pale stone grain is present but soft/uniform, with restrained weathering and weak mineral differentiation. Lagoon lacks optical water depth; marketing is also a stylized decorative lagoon, so transparent water is not an established requirement. Teal seam reads thick/uneven in perspective, but it is disclosed decorative trim, not evidence of a watertight-seal failure.
limitations: Read sources/seychelles/source_readme.md: procedural granite, enamel lagoon, decorative sand, inherited interior hardware and lighter highlights are explicit limits. Readme records corrected lagoon containment and side UV stretching; current stills do not reproduce obvious overflow or gross stretching. Reported sampled motion/attachment checks were not rerun and are not continuous manufacturing certification. Mobile is emulated; no open marketing reference exists.
decision: Choose acceptance of the simplified granite/enamel interpretation or request closer boulder irregularity, stone finish and brass detail before promising promotional equivalence. No proven current containment or mechanism defect. Candidate review only, not user approval.
